data.body:
[P2] Include envelope escaping in the size safeguard

Supported nondefault budgets still permit oversized log events. With `new LambdaLogExporter(1_000_000)`, input containing 300,000 backslashes produces roughly 600 KB of rendered JSON and passes truncation, but this second serialization expands the line to roughly 1.2 MB. A previously fitting record now exceeds the documented 1 MB event limit. Measure the escaped envelope during truncation or enforce a separate final-line cap, and add a regression test covering a nondefault budget.
